messages:
alex: quick heads up — opened PR 5121, it renames a couple of proto fields and runs gofumpt. need one more approval before i squash/rebase and merge
maya: skimmed it. behavior looks the same, but one nit: proto field `UserId` -> `user_id` is fine, but can we keep the json tag `json:\"user_id\"` explicitly so existing consumers stay obvious
kevin: agree with maya. also CI showed a gofumpt diff, run `make format` and push the tidy change
alex: yeah CI flagged it, i'm about to run `make format` locally. do you want me to split the rename into its own PR or keep it with the small formatting changes?
maya: if the rename touches many downstream files, split. here it looks contained so keep it if you add a short commit message about the rename and rationale
kevin: tiny followup: pls avoid changing unrelated whitespace in generated files — just the hand edits and fmt. saves churn in review history
ci-bot: build failed — gofumpt mismatch detected in pkg/ids/encode.go (CI log https://ci.internal/runs/2345)
alex: pushing fix now, will `git commit -am \"format + proto rename: user_id\" && git push --force`
alex: done, pushed. force-pushed to keep history linear
maya: re-running tests locally. LGTM other than the one proto json tag question — can you add that explicit tag in the small commit?
alex: updated proto tag and pushed another patch
kevin: running `make test` locally, all green. approved :thumbsup:
maya: approved :white_check_mark:
alex: awesome, thanks both. i'll merge in the morning during merge window to avoid late-night rollbacks
kevin: sounds good. thanks for handling the fast followups
ci-bot: merge queue updated — PR 5121 scheduled for merge during next window
